The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d` → `packageMentionDocs`.

git fetch origin 9d2ff7252a2528a00c9644dbc5dc9b6629bcc4ee && git checkout 9d2ff7252a2528a00c9644dbc5dc9b6629bcc4ee

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc0db22bcfdbdb778945317fc4de6dc46aab966d

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — RIGHT.** The diff's one source hunk is the `.describe()` string of `GanttConfig.timeZone` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1920`); the member stays `z.string().optional()`, no key is added, removed, renamed, aliased, defaulted or refined, and no other member moves. `authorable-surface/`, `api-surface/` and `json-schema.manifest/` are untouched, and the manifest carries names, not prose (zero hits for the describe's text in any of the three). `Spec property liveness` is success on the head.
- **Public surface: no export moves — RIGHT.** What changes in the published package is the `description` the spec's zod and JSON-Schema output carry for this one member — shipped bytes, not the published accept set (the contract-review reference's own distinction).
- **The new sentence is true of the CONTRACT, not of one renderer — RIGHT.** ADR-0053 (Accepted, Phase 1 implemented) fixes `date` as a timezone-naive `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar day that is never converted to an instant and never timezone-shifted, and `datetime` as an instant stored in UTC. The one rule is `temporalStorageForm` in `packages/core/src/utils/temporal-storage-form.ts` (`date` → `canonicalCalendarDay`, a string's leading `YYYY-MM-DD`; `datetime` → canonical UTC ISO text), and it sits on the write path a gantt drop reaches: `driver-sql`'s `formatInput` runs every `dateFields` member through `toDateOnly`, whose body is `temporalStorageForm(value, 'date')` (`sql-driver.ts`), and `driver-memory`'s write path runs `coerceTemporalValue` (`memory-temporal.ts`), the same rule. So whatever the renderer sends for a `date` column, what persists is a calendar day, and for a `datetime` column the same instant re-spelled in UTC. The old clause "persisted data stays real instants" was false for `date`; the replacement states the rule the platform already had.
- **"the calendar day it was dropped on in this zone's calendar" is a contract statement, not a renderer description — RIGHT.** The same describe's first clause already defines the chart's day columns and snapping as this zone's calendar; a drop lands on one of those columns; and a `date` column persists a calendar day with no instant to shift (ADR-0053), so the day that persists is that column's day. It follows from the contract alone. Cross-checked, read-only, against the only shipped renderer: objectui `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` `toStoredDateValue` writes `toDateInputValue(chartZone.to(date))` for a declared `date` and `date.toISOString()` otherwise (objectui#10866 sites 1 and 2, landed as objectui#10886 in the checkout) — the renderer already does what the sentence says, so it is also a fair statement of what persists today.
- **The DST shim defect is correctly left out — RIGHT.** objectui#10866 slice 5 is a defect in objectui's `makeTzShift` near a DST change (a day's midnight placed an hour early); the contract states the rule, not a renderer's bug. Triage directed the omission; the describe carries no tracker number (`check:doc-authoring` is inside `Lint & Repo Gates`).
- **The four generated doc copies are the generator's output — RIGHT.** The rows at `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` :584 (`### Properties`), :982 (`ListView.gantt`), :1365 (`ObjectListView.gantt`) and `component.mdx` :679 (`ObjectGanttProps.gantt`) change exactly the describe cell and are byte-identical elsewhere; the old phrase has zero hits on the head tree; the new describe contains no `{`, `<`, backslash or pipe, so `escapeMdxDescription` and the cell escaping in `schema-section.ts` pass it through verbatim. The machine proof is `Type Check · source gates` — the job carrying `check:docs` / `check:generated` — which is success on this head.
- **The net diff against current `main` is only this PR's change — RIGHT.** `origin/main...head` = 4 files, +25/−5, matching the PR's file list. The branch is fix (38bce2f) → regen (a6aeb19) → merge of `origin/main` at 9801da1 (ad11217) → driver-deferred regen of `view.mdx` only (192aba1), per `os-regen-merge.sh`. Seat 4's #20474 `view-console-round-trip-keys` symbols count the same on head and on `main` in `view.zod.ts`; the five commits `main` gained after the merge base touch none of the three content paths.
- **objectui's zod mirror is not a landing concern — RIGHT.** `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:2113` takes `stripImportedDefaults(SpecGanttConfigSchema).shape.timeZone` by reference, so it corrects itself at the next spec bump; objectui pins no test on the old text (zero hits). Nothing is removed, so the pinned `.objectui-sha` (`dd3f7e1`) imports nothing this diff drops and `Console Pin Gate` (skipped by path filter) is not owed. objectui's own TS-side prose (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts` `GanttConfig.timeZone`, `makeTzShift`'s docblock) is that repo's card (objectui#10994), not this PR's.
- **Governed surfaces: none — RIGHT.** None of the four paths is on the register; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is success. The tier owed is the clause-② path limb `packages/spec/src/**`, which this record serves.
